rows.topic: **[Core Apps]** PTT (Voice Chats) launch readiness for v24
rows.decision_outcome: Design is escalating 2 blocking requirements with voice chats experience: hands-free initiation and WA late group joiner voice chat access. Decision is needed on the craft bar, which will determine whether the product can launch in v24 or needs to be delayed, potentially indefinitely. From Core Apps review, Miron and Abhi aligned that holding indefinitely on a core OS limitation isn’t the right trade-off and recommended launching in v24 plus looking at options to pull in the WA fix, assuming it is common.
GO approval from Core Apps Lead, aligned with the team’s recommendation in the pre-read. Shared feedback.

**Strategy - **Approved, reviews completed with Wearables and MSL. By Meta AI 2.0 (End of March), we will partially converge the architecture stack across models, tools, context and orchestration. Full convergence will follow post Meta AI 2.0. **Execution - **[Tight tracking](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1b3b48gsRy5sxt2lJYiAJoQTRf92SkfwAcB0mTtyFK-8/edit?tab=t.t2dveje9mx7n) towards exiting by Meta AI 2.0 (Harmony1 milestone) with [instructions and office hours](https://fb.workplace.com/groups/1436164824681830/posts/1443278533970459/). Demo checkins to follow.

Malibu2LE will not support voice search for 2P music on Day0. Instead we will continue to invest in NextGenMusicFramework and once that migration is complete we can extend support for voice search to Malibu2LE
